name: Y Combinator — Fall 2026
notes: Fall 2026 runs October–December in San Francisco.
The on-time deadline was July 27, 2026; late applications are still considered.
This adapter scores readiness using public YC guidance and does not estimate acceptance probability.

name: Techstars — General Pool / Program Fit 2026
notes: Techstars applications can be considered by the general pool and selected programs.
Public guidance emphasizes team history, execution, customer/problem understanding, progress, market, and unfair advantage.
Specific Techstars programs may add geography or vertical constraints not represented by this general adapter.

name: Antler Residency — 2026
notes: Antler publicly describes a founder-first selection process focused on profile, vision, trajectory, drive and judgment.
Applicants select a residency location and must satisfy visa/entry requirements for that location.
The adapter flags missing location/visa evidence as an applicability warning rather than inventing eligibility.

eligibility_rules.message: A preferred residency location and visa/entry feasibility should be confirmed before treating this as an actionable application target.

name: 500 Global Accelerator — Eurasia Batch 11
notes: The final published application deadline was August 9, 2026.
The program targets startups with Eurasia operations, a functional prototype, early revenue, global-market potential, and a cross-functional team.

eligibility_rules.message: 500 Global Eurasia Batch 11 requires direct or indirect operations in one of the published eligible countries.
The published target profile is early-revenue startup stage.
Published program criteria call for early revenue.
Published program criteria call for a functional prototype.
The published target profile calls for a cross-functional team; a one-person team should document how this requirement is met.
